rationale: Bounded repaint scope for script and transformed views (View::request_repaint(Rect) maps through transforms and scroll; a no-op paint setter is free; the bridge skips its whole-surface request after work that marked its own damage), frame requests without damage, a fixed-box Label repainting its own box, and a display-only modulated indicator on Knob and Fader. Paint is clipped to the requested extents, so output is pixel-identical; covered by the listed tests with negative controls. No design-import, Chromium, rendering-backend or packaging authority moves.
